_source: NAC's own photographs of NAC's own installations, supplied by Nick on 15 October 2026. Unlike the generated fixtures in tests/, these are real.
_generated: tools/import-nac-photos.mjs — re-encoded in Chromium and verified with scanMetadata(). Do not hand-edit; re-run the tool.
_notes: No INSTALLATION photographs are publishable. A photograph of a customer’s house needs their suburb and their consent recorded against it before it goes on a proposal, and none of these has either. The gallery is left out rather than filled with equipment shots.
There is no COVER photograph. Every one of these is portrait, and a cover wants a landscape shot of a finished job. The cover falls back to the brand panel until one is supplied.

16 of 16 photographs carry a brand but no model number — the compliance plate is not legible. They are matched to a quote by brand, which is what Nick asked for; a model number recorded later only makes the match sharper.

images.alt: A Zonemaster six-zone wall panel, with a labelled switch for each zone
images.approvalNote: Supplied by Nick on 5 November 2026. A product image of a Zonemaster wall panel. Cropped only: the image was cropped to the panel itself (the supplied file was 527x527 with the panel occupying a 247x376 box) and then centred on white in a 600x600 square, which is the shape the page renders it in. Nothing in it was retouched. Nothing in it was altered. IT IS NOT MATCHED TO ANY CONTROLLER AUTOMATICALLY. NAC's zone kits are recorded as Siemens (MMASEM4ZTPKIT / MMASEM6ZTPKIT / MMASEM8ZTPKIT) and nothing in the library says a Zonemaster panel is the part that ships with them, so controllerImageFor() puts this picture on a controller only when the controller's own name says Zonemaster, or when NAC picks it by hand.
images.seen: A white wall plate badged Zonemaster at the bottom right, carrying six labelled buttons in a column with a round illuminated switch beside each. The labels read FAMILY, LOUNGE, MASTER, BEDROOM 2, BEDROOM 3 and STUDY. Five of the rings are lit blue; the one beside BEDROOM 2 is pale, so that zone is off.
